segments.text: How much contract code can you deploy before the protocol rejects it?
Runtime code and deployment initcode have separate size walls. Glamsterdam raises both.
Start one byte beyond the old twenty-four kibibyte runtime wall.
Initcode has its own limit: forty-eight kibibytes plus one.
Fusaka rejects. Glamsterdam reaches one hundred twenty-eight kibibytes.
Runtime: twenty-four to sixty-four. Initcode: forty-eight to one hundred twenty-eight. One byte past sixty-four still fails. Fusaka keeps the old walls.
Read the spec. Try every boundary on feelyourprotocol dot org.
